headlines.text: That Sunday in 2026, Jon Moxley vs. Bandido put the AEW Continental Title on the line, appearing on Forbidden Door, rated 8.33 ? a fantastic contest. Moxley choked out Bandido to retain the AEW Continental Title in a hard-fought technical battle.

It was 2023 when Allin & Sting vs. Guevara & Jericho fought it out in a Tornado Tag match, in the show-closing main event slot on Dynamite, rated 7.25 ? a solid showing in a back-and-forth tag team affair.

2026 brought us this moment: the IWGP Global Heavyweight Title made its debut as Shota Umino vs. PAC battled for the honor of being first champion, appearing on Forbidden Door, rated 7.58 ? a strong outing. Umino successfully defended the IWGP Global Heavyweight Championship against PAC.

secondaries.text: It was 2026 when Starlight Kid competed under the AEW banner for the first time against Thekla, appearing on Forbidden Door, rated 7.66 ? a good, competitive contest. Thekla, a former STARDOM outcast on a personal crusade against her old promotion, survived a pair of Divine Punishments and a top-rope moonsault before a spear and two curbstomps retained her title ? then cut off Starlight Kid's mask with scissors, spat on it, and used it to beat down watching STARDOM president Taro Okada.

In a war that turned into an absolute bloodbath, Ospreay finally put away Strickland with a Tiger Driver '96 to win the Men's Owen Hart Cup and punch his ticket to Wembley.
